title: Assistente de Vendas (Inglês Fluente)
description:
International Sales Assistant | Remote & Fluent English – C1


At Bluedot BPO Solutions, we connect top LATAM talent with high-performing U.S. sales teams. We are looking for a highly organized and proactive Sales Assistant with strong English skills to support sales operations and outbound prospecting.


This is a fully remote role with daily exposure to the U.S. market and a clear path toward an international sales career.


What We Offer


  • Monthly compensation of R$4,000
  • 100% remote, supporting U.S. sales teams
  • Monday to Friday, 12 PM – 21 PM (BRT)
  • Real long-term position
  • Possibility of growth opportunities (SDR, Account Executive, Leadership)
  • International exposure and multicultural environment
  • Structured training and continuous coaching


Your Responsibilities


  • Support outbound prospecting campaigns for U.S. clients
  • Execute prospecting activities (calls, emails, messages, follow-ups)
  • Qualify B2B leads and maintain an updated pipeline
  • Participate in sales meetings and prepare support materials
  • Log activities and metrics in CRM systems (HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, etc.)
  • Assist with administrative sales routines
  • Follow defined processes and KPIs consistently


What We’re Looking For


  • Advanced English (C1) — strong verbal and written communication
  • Highly organized and able to multitask
  • Resilient, proactive, and goal-oriented profile
  • Comfortable in fast-paced environments
  • Availability to work the proposed shift


Nice to Have


  • Experience in outbound prospecting, B2B/B2C sales, or SDR roles
  • Familiarity with CRMs and sales automation tools
  • Fast learner and tech-savvy mindset
  • KPI-driven profile


Technical Requirements


  • Laptop with i5/i7 (or equivalent) and 12GB+ RAM
  • High-speed internet
  • Professional headset
  • Quiet home office environment


Build your international sales career.


Work directly with U.S. teams and grow in a high-performance environment.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Duration: Long Term

Type: PJ


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and optimize ETL/ELT data pipelines using Python and SQL
  • Lead migration of Adobe-based pipelines to GCP/BigQuery
  • Develop event-driven ingestion pipelines for large-scale data processing
  • Integrate and transform datasets (including media/streaming data) into data warehouses
  • Manage and orchestrate workflows using Apache Airflow / Cloud Composer
  • Ensure data quality, validation, and reconciliation across pipelines
  • Optimize BigQuery performance, storage, and cost efficiency
  • Work across hybrid cloud environments (GCP, AWS, Snowflake)
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable data solutions
  • Maintain clear technical documentation and best practices


Required Skills & Experience

  • 7–9 years of hands-on experience in data engineering

Strong expertise in:

  • Python (data pipelines, scripting, transformation)
  • SQL (advanced queries, performance tuning)
  • Apache Airflow (DAGs, scheduling, orchestration)
  • Google Cloud Platform (GCP) & BigQuery
  • Cloud Composer (managed Airflow)
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, GitHub, and automation workflows

Strong understanding of:

  • Data warehousing (star schema, dimensional modeling)
  • ETL/ELT architecture
  • Data quality frameworks and validation techniques


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Adobe Analytics / Adobe Experience Platform
  • Exposure to AWS and Snowflake in multi-cloud environments
  • Hands-on experience with BigQuery cost optimization
  • Knowledge of media, streaming, or event-based data pipelines

description:
Descrição do Cargo: Auxiliar nas demandas do departamento comercial, Cadastrar clientes no sistema, Cadastrar propostas comerciais no sistema, Consultar CDL (SPC e Serasa) após a proposta ser aprovada, antes da emissão do contrato, Emitir novos contratos após aprovação de propostas, Acompanhamento de assinatura eletrônica de contratos e aditivos, Emitir aditivos a maior, a menor, de renovação, Atualizar parcelas de contratos e aditivos após a entrega, e realizar ajustes quando necessário, com orientação do consultor comercial, Solicitar cotação de equipamento aos fornecedores quando necessário, Repassar informações do fechamento do contrato ao setor operacional para realização do serviço, Encerrar contratos no sistema, Solicitar ao setor operacional a retirada de equipamento em caso de encerramento de contrato ou aditivo menor, Solicitar ao setor operacional a entrega de equipamento ou realização de serviços, Arquivar contratos assinados, Fazer requisições de equipamentos para o estoque, Enviar pedidos ou contratos ao financeiro para faturamento, Arquivar documentos do departamento comercial, Solicitar cotação de logística de viagem para envio de propostas, Comparecer às reuniões e organizar atas relacionadas a pendências de tratativas comerciais, Fazer boletim de medição, Realizar pós-venda com o cliente após a realização do serviço.


  • Operações de BackOffice: Experiência em rotinas administrativas e organização de processos internos para suporte operacional.
  • Comunicação e Atendimento ao Cliente: Habilidades claras de comunicação escrita e verbal, além de experiência no atendimento ao cliente para lidar com demandas de forma profissional e eficiente.
  • Finanças e Vendas: Conhecimento em rotinas financeiras e no suporte a equipes de vendas.
  • Desejável formação em Administração, Contabilidade ou áreas relacionadas, além de habilidades em ferramentas como Excel e sistemas CRM.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Revel Street LLC helps corporate event planners discover and reach private dining venues through an extensive, dependable database. We use LLMs extensively to gather and enrich venue data, streamline the event planning workflow, and reduce the time and effort required to source options for events such as private dining, cocktail receptions, and conferences. We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer to help us improve data quality, fix existing data issues, and ingest more data from APIs and LLM-based sources to complement our current datasets. Our current stack includes React, TanStack, Cloudflare, Django, and Dagster, and we expect you to design solutions that are scalable, testable, and grounded in core engineering fundamentals.

Responsibilities

You’ll proactively turn ambiguous requirements into well-structured engineering plans. You’ll communicate trade-offs and risks early, and you’ll verify outcomes through hands-on testing. You’ll bring a “build, measure, improve” mindset to performance, reliability, and user experience.

  • Design, build, and maintain dbt pipelines for our analytics and operational workloads
  • Build and maintain ETL/ELT processes to ingest data from multiple APIs and other external sources
  • Set up and manage workflows in orchestration platforms such as Dagster
  • Develop and refine our data models to support analytics, reporting, and downstream products
  • Diagnose and fix data quality issues (duplicates, missing fields, inconsistent formats, incorrect mappings, etc.)
  • Implement robust data cleaning and validation checks
  • Integrate LLM-based data enrichment (e.g., using OpenAI or similar APIs) to improve and complement event data
  • Collaborate with our product and ops team to understand data needs and translate them into technical solutions

Requirements

  • Very high English proficiency (clear communication, strong writing, and the ability to collaborate effectively)
  • At least 3 years of data engineering experience including experience with dbt and the modern data stack
  • Some experience with devops, CI/CD, and database management.
  • At least 6 months of experience working exclusively in an agentic coding environment (e.g., Claude Code, Codex)
  • Ability to understand data engineering fundamentals, not just generate code—debugging, reasoning about behavior, and ensuring correctness
  • Some technical college degree

title: Engenheiro DevOps (inglês fluente)
description:
Principais Responsabilidades:


• Instalar, configurar, administrar e dar suporte a sistemas e serviços de Core Banking em diferentes ambientes (DEV/UAT/PROD).

• Automatizar atividades operacionais e de deploy utilizando Rundeck e Ansible (orquestração de jobs, playbooks/roles, inventários e gerenciamento seguro de credenciais).

• Criar e manter runbooks, procedimentos operacionais e documentação padrão para permitir execuções repetíveis e auditáveis.

• Fornecer suporte à produção e participar da resposta a incidentes, incluindo triagem, correção e análises pós-incidente (RCA/gestão de problemas).

• Monitorar a saúde e o desempenho dos sistemas; implementar melhorias proativas em disponibilidade, resiliência e capacidade.

• Gerenciar configuração, aplicação de patches e ciclo de vida de componentes de sistema operacional, middleware e aplicações, garantindo conformidade com controles internos.

• Coordenar o controle, renovação e implantação de certificados digitais (ex.: TLS/SSL), incluindo inventário, monitoramento de vencimento, planejamento de mudanças, validação e documentação para evitar interrupções de serviço.

• Trabalhar com equipes de aplicações, infraestrutura e fornecedores para solucionar problemas complexos de ponta a ponta e garantir resolução no prazo.

• Apoiar o gerenciamento de mudanças, planejando, testando, documentando e executando alterações com avaliação de riscos e aprovações adequadas.

• Contribuir para a melhoria de práticas de CI/CD e releases (controle de versão, gestão de artefatos, consistência de ambientes), quando aplicável.

• Aplicar boas práticas de segurança, incluindo hardening, controle de acesso, gestão de segredos e auditabilidade.


Requisitos:

• Mais de 5 anos em Instituições Financeiras; conhecimento do mercado financeiro brasileiro e de produtos/processos de core banking.

• Experiência prática em DevOps/automação com Rundeck e Ansible.

• Conhecimento em scripts (ex.: PowerShell, Bash, Python) para automação e ferramentas operacionais.

• Sólido conhecimento em Windows e Unix/Linux, incluindo troubleshooting, performance e aplicação de patches.

• Experiência com suporte a aplicações e middleware (ex.: servidores web/app, agendamento batch, transferência de arquivos).

• Experiência com ferramentas/tecnologias corporativas como SQL Server, Oracle, Control-M, MQ, ServiceNow, Splunk, Jira, Nexus, LDAP/AD.

• Conhecimento prático em gestão de certificados (inventário, planejamento de renovação/rotação, implantação e validação pós-mudança).

• Entendimento de conceitos de CI/CD e workflows baseados em Git / pipelines de deploy.

• Forte habilidade de comunicação com stakeholders; capacidade de trabalhar com fornecedores globais/locais e equipes internas.

• Inglês avançado.


Desejável:

• Experiência com SAFe; exposição ao GCP.

• Experiência com iniciativas de migração/modernização.

• Espanhol.

title: Analista SAP ABAP
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional Sênior em SAP ABAP para atuar como referência técnica no desenvolvimento de soluções, com foco em projetos complexos e ambientes modernos.

Essa pessoa será responsável por liderar o desenvolvimento técnico, garantindo qualidade, performance e boas práticas, além de atuar na definição de arquitetura e apoio ao time.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver soluções complexas em ABAP (RICEFW);
  • Atuar com tecnologias modernas como SAP HANA (CDS, AMDP) e OData;
  • Definir padrões técnicos e realizar code review;
  • Desenvolver integrações (SAP PI/PO ou Integration Suite/BTP);
  • Apoiar tecnicamente o time (mentoria);
  • Atuar em troubleshooting e incidentes críticos.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência sólida com ABAP;
  • Vivência com S/4HANA;
  • Domínio de ABAP OO;
  • Experiência com SAP Fiori/UI5 e serviços OData;
  • Experiência com Adobe Forms.


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em SAP BTP;
  • Certificações SAP;
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis;
  • Conhecimento em JavaScript/Node.js.

title: Business Development Representative
description:
Business Development Representative (BDR)


About Us

XDRhub is a specialized sales and business development outsourcing company. We are professional cold-callers dedicated to helping small and mid-sized businesses grow through tailored outbound strategies. Our mission is simple: empower our clients to thrive in today’s competitive marketplace by building their pipelines with high-quality opportunities.


About the Role

As a Business Development Representative (BDR) , you will represent one of our clients and act as the first point of contact for prospective buyers. Your primary responsibility is to proactively identify, engage, and qualify decision-makers (Directors, VPs, and C-level executives).

This role is highly outbound-driven: you will spend your time cold calling, cold emailing, prospecting via LinkedIn, and using modern sales tools to generate meetings. You’ll run early-stage discovery conversations and hand off qualified opportunities to the sales team.

You’ll be working in a fast-paced environment where communication, persistence, and organization are key.


About You

We are looking for a driven, articulate communicator who thrives in outbound sales.

  • English Proficiency – Excellent oral and written English (C1 level or higher). Native-like fluency is required, as you will be speaking directly with US-based executives.
  • Sales Mindset – Fearless hunter mentality with a proven ability to prospect, cold call, and build pipeline.
  • Experience with Sales Solutions(Preferred) – Prior experience engaging HR and Finance executives is a strong plus.
  • Curious & Coachable – Eager to learn and grow; open to feedback, with the ambition to become a top 5% sales professional through our mentoring and training.
  • Self-Starter – Comfortable working independently while collaborating closely with team members.
  • Tech-Savvy – Familiar with tools like Salesforce, HubSpot, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar sales enablement platforms.
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, evolving environment .


Key Responsibilities

Lead Generation

  • Research and identify prospective buyers within target accounts.
  • Cold call and email Director and above level executives to secure meetings and demos.

Team Coordination

  • Work closely with Account Executives to confirm appointments, share call notes, and ensure smooth handoffs.
  • Communicate relevant insights from discovery calls to support the sales team’s success.

Data Management

  • Maintain accurate records of outreach, leads, conversations, and pipeline progress in both our CRM and client CRMs.
  • Track activity, outcomes, and ensure reporting is up to date.

Metrics & KPIs

  • Number of dials per day (150+ average) and meeting conversion rate.
  • Number of meaningful conversations and meetings booked.
  • Email outreach volume and reply rate.
  • Meeting attendance rate.

Schedule

  • Full-time, 40 hours/week.
  • Working hours: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM ET.
  • Open to applicants based in LATAM.

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary + commission (60/40 split).
  • SPIFFs and performance incentives.
  • Training, mentoring, and growth opportunities to become a top-performing sales professional.


P.S. If you cold call me at -eight-eight on WhatsApp or reach out on LinkedIn, you’ll jump to the front of the line.

  • Curious & Coachable – Eager to learn and grow; open to feedback, with the ambition to become a top 5% sales professional through our mentoring and training.
  • Self-Starter – Comfortable working independently while collaborating closely with team members.
  • Tech-Savvy – Familiar with tools like Salesforce, HubSpot, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar sales enablement platforms.
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, evolving environment .


Key Responsibilities

Lead Generation

  • Research and identify prospective buyers within target accounts.
  • Cold call and email Director and above level executives to secure meetings and demos.

Team Coordination

  • Work closely with Account Executives to confirm appointments, share call notes, and ensure smooth handoffs.
  • Communicate relevant insights from discovery calls to support the sales team’s success.

Data Management

  • Maintain accurate records of outreach, leads, conversations, and pipeline progress in both our CRM and client CRMs.
  • Track activity, outcomes, and ensure reporting is up to date.

Metrics & KPIs

  • Number of dials per day (150+ average) and meeting conversion rate.
  • Number of meaningful conversations and meetings booked.
  • Email outreach volume and reply rate.
  • Meeting attendance rate.

Schedule

  • Full-time, 40 hours/week.
  • Working hours: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM ET.
  • Open to applicants based in LATAM.

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary + commission (60/40 split).
  • SPIFFs and performance incentives.
  • Training, mentoring, and growth opportunities to become a top-performing sales professional.


P.S. If you cold call me at -eight-eight on WhatsApp or reach out on LinkedIn, you’ll jump to the front of the line.

title: Cloud FinOps Sênior - AWS, Azure e GCP
description:
Quem somos nós?


Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:


  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?


Estamos em busca de um(a) FinOps Cloud que tenha olhar analítico e proatividade para gerenciar e otimizar custos relacionados à infraestrutura em nuvem. Essa pessoa será responsável por consolidar e apresentar dados financeiros e operacionais, garantindo clareza sobre os gastos da área e fornecendo insights estratégicos para a tomada de decisão.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?


  • Monitorar e analisar os custos da infraestrutura em Cloud e Datadog, identificando os principais ofensores e oportunidades de otimização.
  • Construir dashboards e relatórios financeiros que consolidem a visão de custos da área, garantindo transparência e controle.
  • Estruturar planilhas detalhadas com projeções e estimativas financeiras, facilitando o planejamento e a tomada de decisão.
  • Garantir a correta aplicação de TAGs nos recursos de Cloud para rastreamento preciso dos gastos.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com as áreas de desenvolvimento, operações e finanças para implementar práticas de FinOps e governança de custos.
  • Atuar de forma proativa, antecipando demandas e garantindo segurança nas informações para a liderança.
  • Preparar e apresentar análises estratégicas para a alta gestão, assegurando clareza sobre os investimentos da área.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter:


  • Conhecimento básico em Cloud Computing para extração e análise de custos.
  • Experiência com Datadog para obter dados financeiros e de consumo.
  • Capacidade analítica para identificar os principais ofensores de custos.
  • Entendimento de conceitos financeiros para estruturação de planilhas e estimativas.
  • Habilidade para construir dashboards e relatórios gerenciais (ferramenta flexível).
  • Proatividade e autonomia para investigar, consolidar e reportar informações críticas.
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade para apresentar dados estratégicos para a alta gestão.


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?


  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Mental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+ ;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Física - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass ;
  • Seguro de vida.

title: Vendedor
description:
Descrição da Empresa

A Multicoisas é uma rede de franquias especializada em oferecer soluções práticas e criativas para o dia a dia das pessoas. Com mais de 40 anos de experiência, a marca é consolidada no mercado brasileiro e possui mais de 150 lojas em todo o Brasil.

Somos a maior rede de varejo brasileira no segmento de utilidades e nos orgulhamos em oferecer soluções, reparos, acessórios e novidades que levam praticidade e conveniência ao dia a dia. Priorizamos a excelência no atendimento ao cliente e a inovação constante, garantindo acessibilidade e qualidade em nossos produtos.

Missão

Oferecer soluções para facilitar o dia a dia das pessoas por meio da excelência no atendimento.

  • Atender clientes com cordialidade, orientando sobre a utilização e o manuseio adequado dos produtos.


Procuramos um Vendedor para atuar em nossa loja localizada na Rua Maracaju, 1549 – Campo Grande/MS.

  • Gostar de vender e de trabalhar com pessoas;

  • Experiência na área comercial varejista será um diferencial;
  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Conhecimento básico em ferramentas do Google Workspace ou Pacote Office. 

Benefícios

  • Vale-refeição ou vale-alimentação;
  • Vale-transporte;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Café da manhã;
  • Parcerias com academias.

title: Virtual Assistant
description:
Virtual Assistant - Fully Remote


About the job:

We are looking for someone who will help our team with various tasks, has excellent written and spoken English skills, and is attentive to detail and organized.


You will be given various tasks to perform, but your major role is to help us with some marketing activities for our agency and our clients. You will be responsible for crafting and sending personalized outreach messages, reporting, creating Canva designs and working with videos, scheduling posts, scheduling meetings, downloading and cleaning databases, and more. Full training is provided.


This is a full-time role Mon-Fri for 40 hours per week with occasional overtime. Work time from 9:30am – 6.00pm New York Time (with a 30-minute break). You will be working with US clients, but you can live outside of the US; therefore, we would like to have someone in our team who knows American Culture and speaks decent English. Experience with appointment setting, understanding a fitness niche and/or having a sales/ business/ marketing background is an advantage. The company may offer growth opportunities depending on performance.


Requirements:

  • Strong English skills, a neutral accent, and familiarity with American culture.
  • Commitment to working 9:30am – 6.00pm New York Time.
  • Excellent communication and organizational skills.
  • Passion for digital marketing and a hunger to learn.
  • Experience in marketing or fitness is a bonus, but not required.
  • Attention to detail is a must (!!!>> When filling out the form, put your postcode as G9999, DO NOT put your real postcode <
  • Comfortable working in a small team and picking up other jobs as required


What We Offer:

  • Enjoy long-term stability and 100% remote.
  • Join a supportive team.
  • Get top-notch training in marketing and beyond.
  • Starting at $600/month with performance bonuses as you grow.
  • Enjoy weekly payments for financial peace of mind.
  • 12 paid vacation days per year as part of your total compensation package.
  • Growth Opportunities and Full Training.


Ready to join us? Apply now here:

title: Fullstack AI Engineer
description:
Fullstack AI Engineer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

As a Fullstack AI Engineer, you will play a key role in the full development lifecycle of a high-impact Generative AI MVP, translating complex architectural requirements into technical solutions. You will be responsible for building the bridge between Azure AI Foundry agents and the end-user, developing robust APIs, integrating RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines, and implementing a simplified frontend. title: Senior Golang Engineer
description:
Please note that the project operates in the UK time zone.


We are seeking a dedicated, motivated, and reliable Senior Golang Engineer who is interested in providing innovative software solutions for our clients. Be a part of our team as we continue to deliver high quality products and services. The Senior Go Engineer will be responsible for building backend services in Go in EKS, as well as some Lambdas. The overall project will be centered around providing product data and managing the product life cycle. If you are an open communicator with a passion for learning, love to think outside the box and you are excited about software development, we are looking for you!


RESPONSIBILITIES

• Use your deep expertise in Go and related technologies to develop high-quality, scalable, maintainable software solutions.

• Make technically sound decisions and champion high standards of coding and architecture best practices.

• Develop and maintain software documentation such as technical specifications and design documents.

• Continually enhance the team’s performance by mentoring, code reviews, and improving current processes in the SDLC.

• Troubleshoot and debug software issues as they arise.

• Collaborate within a cross functional team and be able to transform both functional and non-functional requirements into actionable work.

• Manage communication of progress/status to stakeholders.


WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• At least 4 years of professional software development experience.

• Proficiency in Go (Golang), including syntax, semantics, database connectivity, and object-oriented concepts.

• Strong understanding of data structures and algorithms.

• Experience working with Go frameworks such as Gin, Revel, Echo, Beego, etc.

• Strong understanding of web services (HTTP, SOAP, REST, GQL, etc.).

• Terraform, Lambdas, Writing API’s.

• Strong working knowledge of relational databases.

• Experience in troubleshooting issues and root cause analysis.

• A proven track record of delivering high quality and tested software on-time and often.

• An open mind, and the patience to explain issues in a constructive manner.

• Strong communication skills, with at least an intermediate level of English.

• Experience working in distributed, cross functional teams.


NICE TO HAVE

• Kubernetes or EKS.

• Algolia.

• Shopify.

• DynamoDB


Who We Are?

We are a fast growing business and technology consultant company co-founded in 2019. We offer a custom-tailored, white-glove engineering service fit for our clients, because a digital transformation is more than just technology. With a successful track record of being a preferred vendor for Fortune 500 companies and as a trusted partner for some of the industry’s leading companies, our global talent has helped many clients achieve their goals.


What's In It For You

  • We offer 100% remote work
  • Wellness/Fitness package
  • Paid trainings and certifications
  • 22 days of paid leave (27 days in the second year with us)
  • Professional Conferences and Training
  • Global Team Building Activities
  • Access to co-working spaces worldwide


Your applications and referrals are welcome!

A Job? Or a Lifetime Experience? Start Yours Here!


We are a Portuguese technology consulting company with a strong outward look to the rest of Europe. We have 12 years of experience in the market and reached the status of \"large company\" in 2018. Our company is part of the national top 10, with a growth of 250% in the last years.


Work-life balance is part of our DNA. We focus on win-win-win relationships, defining every moment of interaction as an experience with unique conditions. #welcometoyourfuture

  • College degree in Computer Science, IT Engineering, or similar;
  • 5+ years of experience in SAP ABAP development, with a strong focus on HR/HCM modules;
  • Hands-on experience implementing SAP SuccessFactors;
  • Strong knowledge of SAP Business Integration Builder;
  • Solid understanding of SAP HCM processes and HR module configuration;
  • Experience with SAP architecture; knowledge of Outsystems or OpenText is a plus;
  • English proficiency at B2 level or above.
  • Availability to relocate to Portugal with our support.

What will encourage you

  • Being part of a company that has a disruptive action in the technology market;

The Data Engineering team is a software-centric group responsible for building and maintaining high-scale data systems that power a large marketplace platform. We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Data Engineer who can take ownership of end-to-end delivery of complex data infrastructure and high-fidelity integrations.

This is a coding-heavy role that goes beyond traditional data engineering, requiring strong architectural design and the ability to build robust integrations between internal microservices and external partner APIs, in addition to scalable data pipelines.

You will collaborate closely with Data Science, Product, and Core Engineering teams to develop cutting-edge solutions that enhance the company’s data platform capabilities.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop code-driven interfaces between the data platform and internal/external services
  • Own projects from requirements gathering through production deployment and monitoring
  • Build scalable data transformations using dbt
  • Design systems that balance technical excellence with business needs, focusing on reliability and maintainability
  • Leverage AI-assisted coding tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude) to improve development speed and code quality
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Product, and Analytics teams to solve complex data challenges


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Data Engineering with a strong foundation in system design
  • Strong programming skills with the ability to write production-grade, modular Python code
  • Expert-level SQL skills, including complex data modeling and BigQuery performance optimization
  • Deep experience with Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, Composer, Dataflow, etc.)
  • Proven experience building integrations with APIs and working with streaming platforms
  • Advanced hands-on experience with dbt (incremental models, testing, and project organization)
  • Experience using AI coding tools to enhance productivity and code quality
  • Strong experience with Git, CI/CD workflows, and Docker/Kubernetes
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills


Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with data design patterns such as Medallion architecture
  • Experience with Terraform and/or Atlantis


Education

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field

title: AI Product Engineer (React + Django, LLM Agents)
description:
Job Title - AI Product Engineer (React + Django, LLM Agents)


About the Company

Our client is a US-based AI startup building production AI agents for marketing workflows (SEO, social media, email). The team is led by experienced founders with backgrounds at Meta, Google, and Scale AI.

This is a product engineering role, not research. You’ll build AI agents that ship, scale, and are used by real customers.


About the Role

We’re looking for a hands-on AI Product Engineer who can own features end-to-end: frontend, backend, and AI logic.

You will build AI agents inside real products, not demos — working closely with the CTO and founders to design, implement, and iterate quickly.


What You’ll Do

  • Build AI-powered product features using React (frontend) and Django (backend)
  • Implement LLM-based agents that perform real business workflows
  • Design and maintain RAG pipelines (retrieval, chunking, embeddings, evaluation)
  • Integrate third-party APIs, web scraping, and internal data sources
  • Own features from idea → production → iteration
  • Make pragmatic technical decisions in a fast-moving startup environment


Must-Have Requirements

  • 6+ years total engineering experience
  • 4+ years of professional experience as a software / product engineer
  • 2+ years working with LLMs, AI agents, or generative AI systems
  • Strong hands-on experience with React (frontend) and Django (backend)
  • Proven experience building AI agents or LLM-powered features used in production


Solid understanding of RAG systems, including:

  • Retrieval quality tradeoffs
  • Chunking strategies
  • Hallucination risks and mitigation
  • Comfortable working without heavy frameworks or abstractions
  • Able to explain technical decisions clearly, concretely, and concisely
  • Startup mindset: moves fast, owns outcomes, and ships
  • Experience with Pinecone, pgvector, or similar vector databases
  • Web scraping, data ingestion pipelines, or third-party API integrations
  • Prior experience in marketing, SEO, or growth-related products


Logistics

  • Full-time (40 hrs/week). US Time Zones
  • Starting ASAP

title: Customer Onboarding Specialist
description:
About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered communications platform for real estate professionals in the U.S., powering tens of millions of text and voice conversations every month, helping real estate professionals close more deals.


We’re expanding our Customer Success team and hiring a high-performing Onboarding Specialist. You will own the customers' first 30 - 45 days, set the tone for the relationship, build confidence and ensure customers are ready quickly and correctly. This role defines the customer’s first impression of Smarter Contact and has clear growth potential within a fast-scaling SaaS company. This is a direct-hire role.


What You’ll Own:

  • Lead and follow up on all 1-1 or group onboarding sessions via phone, video, text, and email using our own tech stack
  • Complete all daily CRM tasks (to-dos, emails, texts, calls, etc.)
  • Guide customers through initial setup, configuration, and first live campaigns
  • Establish clear expectations for SMS performance, compliance, and best practices
  • Reinforce Smarter Contact’s value proposition, positioning, and differentiators
  • Ensure customers reach defined activation milestones within the onboarding window
  • Proactively identify confusion, friction, or risk during onboarding-escalate and resolve
  • Document onboarding outcomes, next steps, and handoff notes clearly in CRM
  • Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Experience to ensure a clean transition post onboarding.
  • Work a minimum of 40 hours/week between 10 AM - 7 pm Eastern Standard Time, Monday to Friday

title: Data Analyst
description:
About The Role


You'll join the Reporting & Analytics team at Pride Global — a high-impact, cross-functional group responsible for delivering data-driven insights across our global staffing operations.

This role sits at the center of how the business makes decisions. You’ll be responsible for building the reporting layer that powers executive dashboards, client presentations, and operational insights across the US, Canada, UK, and Brazil.

This is not just a dashboarding role. You’ll translate complex workforce, financial, and market data into clear, actionable narratives used by senior leadership and global business heads.

We need someone who can take ambiguous business questions, structure them into analytical problems, and deliver high-quality reporting solutions end-to-end — from data modeling to final presentation.


What You’ll Do

  • Design and develop Power BI dashboards used in executive-level reporting and client-facing presentations
  • Build self-service reporting solutions that allow business stakeholders to explore data independently
  • Create clean, intuitive, and visually effective dashboards optimized for both desktop and mobile consumption
  • Develop and manage Power BI datasets, workspaces, and deployment pipelines across Dev / UAT / Prod
  • Model data using star and snowflake schemas, applying best practices in DAX and Power Query (M)
  • Integrate and transform data from multiple sources — ATS, VMS/MSP platforms, SQL databases, Excel, SharePoint, and HR/ERP systems
  • Partner with business leaders to understand reporting needs and translate them into structured analytical outputs
  • Present insights and guide stakeholders through dashboards, explaining trends, limitations, and opportunities
  • Support recurring reporting cycles (weekly, monthly, quarterly) with accurate and timely delivery
  • Define and standardize key business metrics (headcount, spend, fill rates, aging, profitability, etc.)
  • Implement data quality checks, anomaly detection, and validation rules within reporting layers
  • Document data models, metric definitions, and reporting logic to ensure long-term scalability and governance


What We’re Looking For

Must have (3–5 years of experience):

  • Strong hands-on experience with Power BI (DAX, Power Query, data modeling, RLS)
  • Solid SQL skills (joins, aggregations, query optimization, working with relational databases)
  • Experience building reporting solutions for operational, workforce, or business performance data
  • Proven ability to design clean, executive-level dashboards with clear storytelling and minimal noise
  • Experience managing Power BI Service (workspaces, refresh schedules, access control, deployments)
  • Ability to translate business needs into analytical solutions and communicate insights effectively
  • Strong English communication skills (you’ll work with global stakeholders daily)


Nice to have:

  • Experience in staffing, workforce, or HR analytics
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, or similar cloud data platforms
  • Basic experience with Python or R for data preparation or automation
  • Exposure to data governance practices (metric standardization, data lineage, documentation)
  • Experience working in cross-functional environments (finance, operations, delivery teams)

We need someone who can take ambiguous business questions, structure them into analytical problems, and deliver high-quality reporting solutions end-to-end — from data modeling to final presentation.


What You’ll Do

  • Design and develop Power BI dashboards used in executive-level reporting and client-facing presentations
  • Build self-service reporting solutions that allow business stakeholders to explore data independently
  • Create clean, intuitive, and visually effective dashboards optimized for both desktop and mobile consumption
  • Develop and manage Power BI datasets, workspaces, and deployment pipelines across Dev / UAT / Prod
  • Model data using star and snowflake schemas, applying best practices in DAX and Power Query (M)
  • Integrate and transform data from multiple sources — ATS, VMS/MSP platforms, SQL databases, Excel, SharePoint, and HR/ERP systems
  • Partner with business leaders to understand reporting needs and translate them into structured analytical outputs
  • Present insights and guide stakeholders through dashboards, explaining trends, limitations, and opportunities
  • Support recurring reporting cycles (weekly, monthly, quarterly) with accurate and timely delivery
  • Define and standardize key business metrics (headcount, spend, fill rates, aging, profitability, etc.)
  • Implement data quality checks, anomaly detection, and validation rules within reporting layers
  • Document data models, metric definitions, and reporting logic to ensure long-term scalability and governance


What We’re Looking For

Must have (3–5 years of experience):

  • Strong hands-on experience with Power BI (DAX, Power Query, data modeling, RLS)
  • Solid SQL skills (joins, aggregations, query optimization, working with relational databases)
  • Experience building reporting solutions for operational, workforce, or business performance data
  • Proven ability to design clean, executive-level dashboards with clear storytelling and minimal noise
  • Experience managing Power BI Service (workspaces, refresh schedules, access control, deployments)
  • Ability to translate business needs into analytical solutions and communicate insights effectively
  • Strong English communication skills (you’ll work with global stakeholders daily)


Nice to have:

  • Experience in staffing, workforce, or HR analytics
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, or similar cloud data platforms
  • Basic experience with Python or R for data preparation or automation
  • Exposure to data governance practices (metric standardization, data lineage, documentation)
  • Experience working in cross-functional environments (finance, operations, delivery teams)

title: Customer Service Representative
description:
We are seeking a Customer Service / Sales Support Specialist to join our growing team. In this role, you will serve as a key link between our clients, partners, and internal teams. Your primary responsibility will be to help users throughout their experience on our platform, ensuring they can communicate smoothly and receive exceptional service. 


Responsibilities:  

  • Provide frontline support to clients during account registration, identity verification, deposits, withdrawals, and general platform use. 
  • Respond to customer inquiries via live chat, email, and phone with professionalism, empathy, and clarity. 
  • Monitor and resolve issues related to account access, transactions, and platform functionality, escalating when necessary. 
  • Collaborate with the sales and operations teams to ensure timely follow-up and a seamless customer experience. 
  • Maintain accurate client and partner information in CRM systems. 
  • Support service campaigns focused on client satisfaction, retention, and community engagement. 
  • Track common questions and issues to help improve internal processes and FAQs. 

Qualifications:  

  • 1–2 years of experience in customer service or sales support roles. 
  • Strong communication skills in English (professional level). 
  • Empathetic, patient, and solution-oriented when dealing with customers. 
  • Comfortable using CRM tools (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce). 
  • Detail-oriented and organized, with the ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment. 
  • Experience in fintech, digital platforms, or affiliate programs is a plus. 

What We Offer:  

  • Ongoing training and growth opportunities 
  • Supportive team culture 
  • Exposure to a global customer base and a fast-evolving industry 


Job type: Full-Time (Remote) 

Pay: $700USD/month

title: Consulting Partner
description:
ERA Group, a global leader in cost management and business optimisation, is looking for an entrepreneurial Partner to join our international network of consultants.

This is not a traditional consultancy role; it’s a chance to run your own practice within a global brand, with the freedom to shape your market, build your team, and grow your client base while backed by ERA’s proven methodologies, tools, and worldwide community.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead cost optimisation, procurement, and performance improvement programmes across industries
  • Build and grow your client portfolio through business development and long-term partnerships
  • Take ownership of your practice’s strategic direction, go-to-market approach, and team leadership
  • Work directly with C-level clients to deliver measurable savings and transformation


What You Bring

  • Extensive consulting or senior leadership experience in cost management, procurement, or performance improvement
  • A strong track record of client acquisition and project delivery
  • Deep expertise in one or more industries such as Pharma/Life Sciences, Energy/Utilities, Manufacturing, Consumer, or Logistics
  • Confidence in engaging with CxO-level stakeholders and leveraging your professional network
  • An entrepreneurial mindset with the ambition to grow a successful consulting practice



This is the ideal next step if you’re seeking less bureaucracy, more independence, and the chance to build something of your own within a global consultancy platform.


By applying, you agree to the use of your personal data for recruitment and related communications, in accordance with the UK GDPR.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Job Title: Senior Data Engineer

Location: Brazil

Work Mode: 100% Remote

Employment Type: Independent Contractor (hourly pay, no benefits, candidate responsible for own taxes)

Contract: 6 Months (with possibility of extension)

Hours: 40 hours per week


About the Role

We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Data Engineer to join a software-centric data engineering team responsible for building and maintaining high-scale data systems. This role involves owning the end-to-end delivery of complex data infrastructure and high-fidelity integrations.

This is a coding-heavy position requiring strong expertise in building robust integrations between internal microservices and external partner APIs, as well as developing scalable data pipelines. You will collaborate closely with Data Science, Product and Engineering teams to deliver advanced data platform capabilities.


Responsibilities

  • Design and develop code-driven interfaces between the data platform and internal/external services
  • Take projects from initial requirements gathering through to production deployment and proactive monitoring
  • Build scalable data transformations using dbt
  • Design systems that balance technical excellence with business needs, ensuring reliability and long-term maintainability
  • Leverage AI-assisted coding tools (such as Cursor, Claude) to improve development speed and code quality
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Product, and Analytics teams to solve complex data challenges


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience in Data Engineering with a strong foundation in system design
  • Strong coding skills with the ability to write production-grade, modular Python code
  • Expert-level proficiency in SQL, including complex data modeling and query optimization
  • Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, Composer, Dataflow, etc.)
  • Proven experience building integrations using APIs and working with streaming platforms
  • Advanced hands-on experience with dbt (incremental models, testing, project organization)
  • Experience using AI coding tools to enhance productivity and code quality
  • Strong experience with Git, CI/CD workflows, and Docker/Kubernetes
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills


Preferred Requirements

  • Knowledge of data design patterns such as Medallion architecture
  • Experience with Terraform or Atlantis

title: Video Editor — E-commerce Ads
description:
About Us:

We run 3 health brands across the US and EU. By end of 2025 we were doing $50K days with a team of 3. Now we are scaling to $150K days and need editors who want to own their craft.


About the Role:

You will edit video ads for Meta that actually convert. You see the results. You iterate. When your ads win, you get paid for it.


Responsibilities:

- Edit short and long form video ads for Meta

- Source b-roll from TikTok, Instagram, Pinterest

- Create hook variations

- Same day turnarounds on variations


Requirements:

- Experience editing Meta ads for e-commerce

- Understanding of what makes an ad convert - hooks, pacing, visuals

- Premiere Pro, CapCut, or similar

- Ability to work independently


Compensation:

- $2,000-$5,000 USD/month base depending on experience

- Performance bonuses up to $500/month per brand for top performing ads

- Full training program provided before you start


Job type: Full-time or Part-time

Schedule: Flexible

Location: Remote

title: Data Annotator - Portuguese
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.


Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.


About the Role


Job Title: Data Annotator

Employment Type: Freelance / Project-Based

Location: Remote (Work From Home)

Work Hours: Flexible; minimum commitment of 4–5 hours per day

Eligibility: Open to candidates with a Bachelor’s degree



We are seeking Data Annotator to support a data annotation and linguistic quality project aimed at training Large Language Models (LLMs) . This is a freelance, remote opportunity that offers flexible working hours.

The role involves understanding cultural and linguistic nuances, reviewing and annotating data, and following detailed project-specific guidelines to enhance AI performance and accuracy.


Key Responsibilities


  • Perform data annotation, and text evaluation in accordance with project-specific guidelines.
  • Ensure high-quality, accurate, and contextually relevant annotations to support Large Language Model (LLM) training.
  • Review, validate, and refine AI-generated content for grammatical, semantic, and contextual accuracy.
  • Maintain consistency and quality across all deliverables while adhering to established project standards and timelines.
  • Collaborate effectively with the project team to provide feedback and contribute to continuous improvement.
  • Maintain strict confidentiality and comply with all project deadlines and quality assurance protocols.


Required Skills & Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree in mandatory.
  • Native proficiency in German language and the English language
  • Prior experience in data annotation , linguistic evaluation , or AI training projects.


What Makes This Role Exciting


  • Fully remote opportunity , allowing you to work comfortably from home.
  • Flexible working hours (4–5 hours per day) to suit your schedule.
  • The chance to contribute to cutting-edge AI and Large Language Model (LLM) training initiatives , shaping the future of language technology.


Note:

For this role, you are required to complete the English assessment within two (2) days from the date it is assigned to you.

title: Senior Frontend Developer (100% Remote Worldwide)
description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.


Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.


Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?


About the job

As a senior Frontend Developer, you will be a part of the team that works on the development and maintenance of the frontend components of multiple applications related to the platform. This includes:

  • New Products and Features - Tether continuously strives to create innovative new features in order to provide the most professional experience for customers. These are developed and deployed using agile methodologies, to ensure the user experience remains the best in the industry.
  • Performance - all ui components that power Tether platform must remain effortlessly smooth, responsive, and real-time for customers as the platform continues to scale to accommodate new user growth.
  • Security - Tether makes Security its most important feature. The Frontend Development team is responsible for building all the interactions with API services with the highest security principles and standard, in order to protect the safety of the entire user base.


Responsibilities

Collaborate with the team to work on the development of the Bitfinex KYC webapps. Including:

  • New Features: Create innovative new features in order to provide the most professional KYC experience for customers and compliance officers. These are developed and deployed using agile methodologies.
  • Scalability: The web application must remain effortlessly smooth, responsive, and real-time for customers as the platform continues to scale to accommodate new user growth.
  • Design: Build beautiful reactive applications and trading tools.
  • Domain knowledge: willing to learn the domain-related logic and condition-based logic, including the one based on difference between multiple users scenarios and combinations of factors
  • Debugging: Being able to debug hidden/hard to find issues when needed, advanced usage of browser debugging tools, including network, source, stop points etc.


Requirements

  • With 5+ years of proven experience in software development, with a strong focus on Frontend.
  • Knowledgeable and experienced with micro-service architecture.
  • Comfortable with high-availability concepts.
  • Highly proficient in JavaScript and ES6+.
  • Thoroughly experienced with React, SASS, Redux, build tools and the core principles surrounding these.
  • Some backend experience to be able to run the app locally via NodeJS, with MongoDB, configuring ports and local environment
  • Familiar with modern front-end pipelines and tools.
  • Experienced with RESTful and RPC-based APIs.
  • Interest in bringing diverse, innovative applications to life.
  • Interest in modernising and optimising different web applications.


Important information for candidates

Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:
  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io
  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

title: AI /ML Developer | specialist
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Projetar e implementar soluções de Machine Learning e GenAI end-to-end
  • Definir e evoluir arquiteturas de AI escaláveis, seguras e resilientes
  • Desenvolver, treinar, avaliar e operacionalizar modelos de ML e LLMs
  • Criar e manter pipelines de dados, treinamento e deployment
  • Atuar com Prompt Engineering, RAG, agentes e orquestração de workflows de AI
  • Implementar práticas de MLOps (versionamento, monitoramento e governança)

  • Desenvolver APIs, serviços e automações com foco em qualidade

  • Apoiar decisões técnicas com visão estratégica e foco em negócio


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Experiência sólida como ML Engineer Sênior ou equivalente
  • Forte vivência com Machine Learning em produção
  • Domínio de Kubernetes (K8s) e Helm
  • Experiência com CI/CD aplicado a ML e software
  • Background robusto em engenharia de software
  • Experiência com arquitetura de soluções de AI/ML
  • Atuação em projetos end-to-end (E2E)
  • Experiência com cloud (OCI e/ou GCP)

  • Experiência com MLflow, Kedro, Apache Airflow ou similares
  • Vivência com RAG, agentes autônomos e avaliação de LLMs
  • Conhecimento em FinOps aplicado a workloads de AI

title: Senior Studio Specialist
description:
JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of science video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


As a Senior Studio Specialist at JoVE , you will drive the operational excellence of our in-house creative studio. You will execute and oversee project execution, optimize workflows, and introduce AI-powered solutions to enhance efficiency, quality, and scalability.

This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who understands the full creative production lifecycle and thrives in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment - a love for science is a plus!


Responsibilities:

  • Oversee and coordinate the execution of creative projects from brief to final delivery
  • Maintain the studio production schedule and assign projects to the in-house motion graphics team based on availability, timelines, and project scope.
  • Track the day-to-day progress of projects in the pipeline, follow up on deadlines, flag delays, and ensure workload distribution supports on-time delivery.
  • Define and track KPIs, deadlines, and performance metrics to ensure smooth production cycles
  • Work closely with the Director of Marketing to translate business objectives into actionable creative plans
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to refine briefs and propose effective design solutions
  • Create and edit high-quality video assets to support marketing campaigns, product launches, digital initiatives, and brand awareness efforts.
  • Design, document, and continuously improve studio workflows and cross-functional processes
  • Ensure brand consistency and creative quality standards across all deliverables
  • Identify bottlenecks and implement scalable improvements to increase efficiency
  • Lead the integration of AI technologies into creative workflows, including automation, asset generation, project tracking, and quality optimization


Requirements:

  • 5–7 years of experience in creative production, studio coordination, or motion graphics environments
  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent creative projects while ensuring quality and on-time delivery
  • Strong experience supporting and improving production workflows within creative teams
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate designers and balance workloads effectively in a fast-paced environment
  • Proficiency with project management tools such as Asana (or similar platforms)
  • Hands-on experience leveraging AI tools to improve production efficiency and creative output
  • Strong attention to detail and quality control across all stages of the creative process
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders
  • Solid understanding of the end-to-end creative production lifecycle (briefing, design, review, revisions, final delivery)


Why Join JoVE?

  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Business Strategy Consultant
description:
Organizations collect mountains of data about their customers — and still struggle to act on it. They run surveys, build dashboards, and generate reports, but often lack the structured thinking to turn those outputs into decisions that actually change the business. This role exists to close that gap.


Responsibilities:

  • Diagnosing drivers of customer satisfaction, loyalty, and operational performance across enterprise clients.
  • Structuring insights from large datasets and Voice of Customer programs into strategic recommendations.
  • Developing analytical frameworks that connect behavioral and operational data to business outcomes.
  • Building executive presentations and data-driven narratives for C-level and senior stakeholders.
  • Contributing to consulting proposals and new service offerings — translating insights into commercial value propositions.
  • Supporting the development of consulting methodologies, tools, and analytical approaches.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, Statistics, Data Science, or Marketing.
  • 3–6 years of experience in roles such as Strategy consulting, Business analytics or insights, Strategic planning, Business intelligence, or data-driven product roles.
  • Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese.


Desired Skills:

  • Fluency in Spanish.
  • Experience with customer analytics, Voice of Customer programs, or customer journey analysis.

  • Experiência com AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB)

  • Versionamento com Git

title: Médico Oncologista Genético (com RQE)
description:
*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ONCOLOGISTA GENÉTICO NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Oncologia Genética! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


* SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


* O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Oncologia Genética, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos.


*PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES*


  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Oncologista Genético de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios oncológicos.


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anmneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em Nefrologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais da especialidade Nefrologia através de videochamadas.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças de ordem Oncologista Genética.


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Oncologista Genética.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.


REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ONCOLOGIA.


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista em Oncologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho do respectivo Estado);
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);



Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Oncologia sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina.


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Competência em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.



Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.



Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO


Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo.



IMPORTANTE:


MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo.


Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Oncologista.

Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


* O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Oncologia Genética, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos.


*PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES*


  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Oncologista Genético de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios oncológicos.


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anmneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em Nefrologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais da especialidade Nefrologia através de videochamadas.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças de ordem Oncologista Genética.


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Oncologista Genética.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.


REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ONCOLOGIA.


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista em Oncologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho do respectivo Estado);
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);



Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Oncologia sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina.


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Competência em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.



Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.



Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO


Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo.



IMPORTANTE:


MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo.


Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Oncologista.

title: Logistics Business Analyst
description:
Business Analyst – Transportation / OTM


Must Haves:

• Strong Transportation Management and Intermodal domain knowledge

• Proven experience gathering requirements and writing user stories

• Ability to document process flows and translate operational needs to IT

• Experience working between Operations and IT teams

• Fluent English communication (verbal and written)

• Oracle Transportation Management (OTM) experience required from day one


Nice to Have:

• Experience with QuantumEdge (QE) or similar TMS platforms

• Experience using Figma, Visio, or similar process mapping tools

• Exposure to global or distributed teams (LATAM, Poland, India)

• Experience supporting post go live or postcare rollouts


Day to Day:

You will act as the IT liaison between Transportation Operations and system teams, gathering, documenting, and validating operational requirements mid project. Responsibilities include translating requirements into OTM and QE system enhancements, supporting postcare rollout and future WMS implementation efforts, partnering closely with Project Managers and intermodal operations teams, documenting end to end transportation and intermodal process flows, creating and maintaining training and process documentation, ensuring tickets and enhancements are logged and tracked appropriately, and supporting rail/intermodal teams while balancing up to two projects simultaneously.


*Please Read*

Duration: This is expected to be a 12 month engagement

Location: Remote

Pay: 12.51/hr to 16.67/hr USD or R$10,000 to R$13,333 monthly
